title: Israeli Settlers Attack Palestinian Family in West Bank on October 7 Anniversary
detail: Israeli settlers attacked a Palestinian family in the West Bank, the latest in a pattern of escalating settler violence that has intensified around the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 attacks. The incident reflects heightened tensions across the occupied West Bank as the anniversary renewed both Israeli and Palestinian grief and anger. Rights groups have documented a significant increase in settler attacks on Palestinian communities in the period surrounding the anniversary.
